content: Musa iqeǧeb marra řxedmet uca ibarek řgens
Ggin ɛawed arruḍ i tsexxart s ufiři adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen, ḥima ad zzayes sexxaren ikehhanen di Zzawect Iqeddsen. Ɛawed ggin arruḍ iqeddsen i Harun, am mammec d as yumur SIDI i Musa.
Igga apalṭu n ukehhan s ifiřan n wureɣ u s ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen u s řeqṭen azdad imuden.
Nitni bezzɛen tiřwiḥin n wureɣ uca qessen zzaysent ifiřan, ḥima ad ten xeyyḍen jar ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen u jar řeqṭen azdad, d man aya tuɣa d ict n řxedmet am tt ittegg ufennan.
Ggin as tiɣarḍin imseřsaqen uca ssmunen apalṭu ɣar tnayen n ixfawen nnes.

Taḥezzamt izewwqen i tuɣa ɣar upalṭu nnes, tuɣa teřseq dayes, tedweř d ict akides. Tᵉttwagg tḥezzamt s webrid d ijjen ak-d upalṭu s ifiřan n wureɣ u s ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen u s řeqṭen azdad imuden, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Nitni ggin ɛawed iẓra n uniks, inni ittwaṭṭfen di tcuyar n wureɣ, neqcen ten am yijj n wenqac n txadent n ucemmiɛ s ismawen n ayt n Israil.
Igga i-ten x tɣarḍin n upalṭu, am iẓra n řidaret i ayt n Israil, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Igga tajmect, ict n řxedmet am tt ittegg ufennan, am mammec igga apalṭu, s ifiřan n wureɣ u s ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen u s řeqṭen azdad imuden.
Tuɣa-tt s arebɛa n tɣemmura. Ḍefsen tajmect. Tuɣa tuzzeggart nnes d ijj n wezyen n uɣiř, uca uřa d tiru nnes d ijj n wezyen n uɣiř. Tuɣa iḍfes x tnayen.
Settfen dayes arebɛa n řeṣfuf n yeẓra: ijj n ṣṣef s yijj n řeɛqiq d azeggwaɣ d ict n tyaqut d yict n smaraxt. D wa d ṣṣef amezwar.
Ṣṣef wiss tnayen s yijj n karbunkel d yijj n ṣaffir aziza d yijj n diamanti.
Ṣṣef wiss třata s yijj n weẓru n yasintu d yijj n axat d yijj umatist.
Ṣṣef wiss arebɛa s yict n texrisulit d yijj n uniks d yijj n yaspis. Tuɣa ttwaṭṭfen di tcuyar nsen n wureɣ.
Iẓra tuɣa xasen ismawen n ayt n Israil, tenɛac n yeẓra ɛlaḥsab ismawen nsen, s ineqqacen n ijj n ucemmiɛ, kuř aneqqac ak-d yisem nnes i d as dd-yusin. Aqa aten i tenɛac n tqebbař.
Ɣar ixfawen n tejmect ggin tiseddyin s wureɣ iṣfan, tinni imuden am yijj n ufiřu.
Ggin tnayen n tcuyar n wureɣ d tnayen n texrazin n wureɣ uca cedden tnayen n texrazin ɣar tnayen n ixfawen n tejmect.
Cedden tnayen n ssnaseř imuden n wureɣ ɣar tnayen n texrazin ɣar ixfawen n tejmect.
Tnayen n ixfawen nneɣni n tnayen n ssnaseř imuden, cedden ten ɣar tnayen n tcuyar uca wcin ten x ṭɣarḍin n upalṭu, deg wudem n zzat.
Ggin ɛawed tnayen n texrazin n wureɣ, cedden tent ɣar tnayen n ixfawen nneɣni n tejmect, di tma nnes nni qibač i upalṭu, ɣar daxeř.
Ggin ɛawed tnayen n texrazin n wureɣ, cedden tent x tnayen n tɣarḍin n upalṭu n ukehhan, swadday, ɣar zzat, qibač i useřqi nnes ɣar sennej i tḥezzamt izewwqen n upalṭu.

Uca cedden tajmect s texrazin nnes ɣar texrazin n upalṭu n ukehhan ak-d ijj n ufiřu adeḥmi ařami idweř sennej i tḥezzamt izewwqen n upalṭu, uca xenni war tbeṭṭi tejmect x upalṭu, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Igga ɛawed aseřham n upalṭu n ukehhan am mammec t ittegg uxeyyaḍ, tuɣa-t d adeḥmi marra.
Arzam n useřham tuɣa-t di řwesṭ nnes am mammec ggin arzam n yiri n warruḍ n wuzzař n uɛeskari. Deg wenneḍ n warzam tuɣa din ict n tma, ḥima war ittcarrig.
Ɣar tmuwwa n wadday n useřham ggin tiremmanin s ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen zeg ifiřan imuden.
Ggin ɛawed nnwaqes n wureɣ iṣfan uca ssarsen nnwaqes nni jar tremmanin ɣar tmuwwa n wadday n useřham, deg wenneḍ jar tremmanin.
Ijj n nnaqus d ict n tremmant, xenni ɛawed ijj n nnaqus d ict n tremmant ɣar tmuwwa n wadday n useřham deg wenneḍ, maḥend ad dayes ggen tasexxart nsen, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ggin tcamir i Harun d warraw nnes s řeqṭen azdad, am mammec t ittegg uxeyyaḍ,
areẓẓet n řeqṭen azdad d tcuccay izewwqen n řeqṭen azdad d ssraweř n řeqṭen s řeqṭen azdad imuden
u tuɣa taḥezzamt n řeqṭen azdad imuden u n ufiřu adeḥmi d urjuwani d uzeggʷaɣ iḥedqen, aqa-tt d ijj n umudi n uxeyyaḍ, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ggin tařwiḥt s nnuwar n ttaj iqeddsen n weɛzař s wureɣ iṣfan uca neqcen dayes tira-ya: “AMQEDDAS i SIDI!”, am mammec neqcen taxadent n ucemmiɛ.
Uca cedden as ijj n ufiřu imuden adeḥmi, ḥima ad tt ayřen sennej i areẓẓet, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ammu i tkemmeř marra řxedmet n Tzeddiɣt, Aqiḍun n Umsagar. Ayt n Israil aqa ggin tt am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa, ammu i tt ggin.
Ksin Tazeddiɣt ɣar Musa, Aqiḍun d marra řeqcuɛ nnes d tsennarin nnes d tfeřwin nnes d tḥenya nnes n uɛarreḍ d ipilaren nnes d tyarsawin nnes
d tseqqaft n iřmawen izeggʷaɣen n icarriyyen d tseqqaft n iřmawen n ddenfiřat d uřeḥḥaf i dduri,
Ttabut n Cchadet d iɛumad nnes i tarebbut d tqebbart n weṣřaḥ
d tazewḍa ak-d marra řeqcuɛ nnes d weɣrum n wescan
d řqendiř n wureɣ iṣfan d řefnarat nnes - řefnarat nni tuɣa ittxeṣṣa ad ttwasswejdent, d marra řeqcuɛ nnes d zzect i tfawt -
d uɛalṭar n wureɣ d zzect i wedhan d řebxur ittfuḥen d arwaq i wadaf n Uqiḍun
d uɛalṭar n nnḥas s tracca n nnḥas d iɛumad nnes i tarebbut d marra řeqcuɛ nnes d tbanyut ak-d uḍar nnes
d řizarat n řemraḥ ak-d ipilaren nsent d tyarsawin nsen, uřa d arwaq n wadaf n řemraḥ d ifiřan nnes d řewtad nnes d marra řeqcuɛ i tsexxart n Tzeddiɣt, i Uqiḍun n Umsagar
uřa d arruḍ i tsexxart, ḥima ad zzayes sexxaren ikehhanen di Zzawect Iqeddsen, arruḍ iqeddsen i ukehhan Harun d arruḍ i warraw nnes, ḥima ad sexxaren d ikehhanen.
Ggin ayt n Israil marra řxedmet am mammec marra i yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ixzar Musa ɣar marra řxedmet uca iẓra belli tᵉttwagg am mammec yumur SIDI, wah, ammu i-tt ggin. Uca ibark i-ten Musa.
